decision: Keep WebGL context-loss fallback handling and the explicit race exit control. Local built-preview context loss now falls back to Canvas2D and can exit back to the world home with #race cleared.
implementation: ArcadeRace3D handles webglcontextlost/webglcontextrestored, records window.__raceWebGLContextStatus, suspends race audio, clears active input, stops the RAF loop, and requests the existing RaceScreen Canvas2D fallback.
RaceScreen exposes a visible Today exit button on the full-screen race route.
App navigation clears #race when leaving the race route, with memoized callbacks to preserve the WorldMode WebGL lifecycle.

preservation.testRaceBrowser: pass; 24 race completions and 28 visual/control/fallback checks

caveats: This proves local built-preview WebGL context-loss fallback only, not Safari/Firefox/Edge or real-device context-loss behavior.
Desktop performance remains below target; this checkpoint does not close the performance gate.
Preview/prod deployed response, rollback, monitoring/support, and release-owner sign-off evidence remain missing.
